chunks: And in the narration of Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
"You are within the time of Maghrib during travel up to five miles after the sunset."

key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: Abū Baṣīr, the narrator transmitting this report

ai.seo_question: How long does the time of Maghrib continue for a traveler after sunset?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the time of Maghrib prayer for a traveler. It indicates that after sunset, the time of Maghrib remains applicable in travel up to the extent of five miles, reflecting facilitation in prayer rulings during السفر.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1299 - In a narration from Abu Basir, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"You are in the time of Maghrib (evening prayer) while traveling up to a distance of five miles after sunset”.
